description.en: Auntie Edna knows everyone and all the news. She shows you round the village: the shop, the church, the pub, the old bridge and the fells all around.
description.sl: Teta Edna pozna vse in ve vse novice. Pokaže ti vas: trgovino, cerkev, gostilno, stari most in hribe vse naokrog.
description.it: La zia Edna conosce tutti e sa tutte le novità. Ti fa fare il giro del paese: il negozio, la chiesa, il pub, il vecchio ponte e i monti tutt'intorno.
description.de: Tante Edna kennt alle und weiß alle Neuigkeiten. Sie zeigt dir das Dorf: den Laden, die Kirche, den Pub, die alte Brücke und die Berge ringsum.

words.example_en: Our village is small.
words.example_it: Il nostro paese è piccolo.
words.example_de: Unser Dorf ist klein.
words.note: A small place is a village; a bigger one is a town, like Keswick.
words.note_sl: Majhen kraj je village; večji je town, kot Keswick.
words.note_it: Un posto piccolo è un village; uno più grande è una town, come Keswick.
words.note_de: Ein kleiner Ort ist ein village; ein größerer eine town, wie Keswick.

words.example_en: The shop opens at eight.
words.example_it: Il negozio apre alle otto.
words.example_de: Der Laden macht um acht auf.
words.note_it: In britannico shop; gli americani dicono store.

words.example_en: Auntie Edna hears all the news at the post office.
words.example_sl: Teta Edna na pošti izve vse novice.
words.example_it: La zia Edna sente tutte le novità all'ufficio postale.
words.example_de: Tante Edna hört auf der Post alle Neuigkeiten.

words.example_en: The church is small and very old.
words.example_sl: Cerkev je majhna in zelo stara.
words.example_it: La chiesa è piccola e molto antica.
words.example_de: Die Kirche ist klein und sehr alt.

words.example_en: Harry goes to school with Poppy.
words.example_sl: Harry hodi v šolo s Poppy.
words.example_it: Harry va a scuola con Poppy.
words.example_de: Harry geht mit Poppy zur Schule.
words.note: Without the: go to school, at school.
words.note_sl: Brez the: go to school (hoditi v šolo), at school (v šoli).
words.note_it: Senza the: go to school (andare a scuola), at school (a scuola).
words.note_de: Ohne the: go to school (zur Schule gehen), at school (in der Schule).

words.example_en: Our pub is called the Packhorse Inn.
words.example_sl: Naši gostilni je ime Packhorse Inn.
words.example_it: Il nostro pub si chiama Packhorse Inn.
words.example_de: Unser Pub heißt Packhorse Inn.
words.note: An inn is an old pub with rooms. Families eat there, too.
words.note_sl: Inn je stara gostilna s sobami. Tam jedo tudi družine.
words.note_it: Un inn è un vecchio pub con camere. Ci mangiano anche le famiglie.
words.note_de: Ein inn ist ein alter Pub mit Zimmern. Dort essen auch Familien.

words.example_en: Mrs Birkett buys eggs at the market.
words.example_sl: Gospa Birkett kupi jajca na tržnici.
words.example_it: La signora Birkett compra le uova al mercato.
words.example_de: Frau Birkett kauft Eier auf dem Markt.

words.example_en: Be careful when you cross the road!
words.example_it: Attento quando attraversi la strada!
words.example_de: Pass auf, wenn du über die Straße gehst!
words.note: In Britain cars drive on the left: look right first!
words.note_sl: V Britaniji vozijo po levi: najprej poglej desno!
words.note_it: In Gran Bretagna si guida a sinistra: guarda prima a destra!
words.note_de: In Großbritannien fährt man links: Schau zuerst nach rechts!

words.example_en: The old stone bridge goes over the beck.
words.example_sl: Stari kamniti most gre čez potok.
words.example_it: Il vecchio ponte di pietra passa sopra il ruscello.
words.example_de: Die alte Steinbrücke führt über den Bach.
words.note: A packhorse bridge is an old narrow bridge, made for horses carrying goods.
words.note_sl: Packhorse bridge je star ozek most za tovorne konje.
words.note_it: Un packhorse bridge è un vecchio ponte stretto, fatto per i cavalli da soma.
words.note_de: Eine packhorse bridge ist eine alte, schmale Brücke für Packpferde.

words.example_en: Alfie is splashing in the beck.
words.example_it: Alfie sguazza nel ruscello.
words.example_de: Alfie planscht im Bach.
words.note: The Cumbrian word for a stream; in the rest of England people say stream.
words.note_sl: Cumbrijska beseda za potok; drugod po Angliji rečejo stream.
words.note_it: La parola della Cumbria per ruscello; nel resto dell'Inghilterra si dice stream.
words.note_de: Das Wort aus Cumbria für Bach (verwandt mit Bach!); im übrigen England sagt man stream.

words.example_en: Derwentwater is a big lake.
words.example_it: Derwentwater è un grande lago.
words.example_de: Derwentwater ist ein großer See.
words.note: A lake is not the sea: the sea is salty, like at Whitehaven.
words.note_sl: Lake je jezero; morje je sea.
words.note_it: Lake è il lago; il mare è sea.
words.note_de: Vorsicht: der See ist lake; die See, das Meer, ist sea.

words.example_en: Jack's sheep are up on the hill.
words.example_sl: Jackove ovce so zgoraj na hribu.
words.example_it: Le pecore di Jack sono su in collina.
words.example_de: Jacks Schafe sind oben auf dem Hügel.
words.note: The high hills here are called fells.
words.note_it: Le colline alte qui si chiamano fells.
words.note_de: Die hohen Berge hier heißen fells.

words.example_en: Mr Tyson's farm is by the beck.
words.example_sl: Kmetija gospoda Tysona je ob potoku.
words.example_it: La fattoria del signor Tyson è vicino al ruscello.
words.example_de: Herr Tysons Hof liegt am Bach.

words.example_en: Mr Tyson's oats grow in the big field.
words.example_sl: Oves gospoda Tysona raste na velikem polju.
words.example_it: L'avena del signor Tyson cresce nel campo grande.
words.example_de: Herr Tysons Hafer wächst auf dem großen Feld.

words.example_en: The sheep are on the road again!
words.example_it: Le pecore sono di nuovo sulla strada!
words.example_de: Die Schafe sind schon wieder auf der Straße!
words.note: One sheep, two sheep: the plural doesn't change. Never sheeps!
words.note_sl: One sheep, two sheep: množina je enaka. Nikoli sheeps!
words.note_it: One sheep, two sheep: il plurale non cambia. Mai sheeps!
words.note_de: One sheep, two sheep: Die Mehrzahl bleibt gleich. Nie sheeps!

words.example_en: Auntie Edna talks to all the neighbours.
words.example_sl: Teta Edna klepeta z vsemi sosedi.
words.example_it: La zia Edna chiacchiera con tutti i vicini.
words.example_de: Tante Edna plaudert mit allen Nachbarn.
words.note: British spelling neighbour (American neighbor). The gh is silent.
words.note_sl: Britanski zapis neighbour (ameriško neighbor). Črk gh ne izgovoriš.
words.note_it: Grafia britannica neighbour (americana neighbor). Il gh è muto.
words.note_de: Britische Schreibung neighbour (amerikanisch neighbor). Das gh ist stumm.

words.example_en: The bus to Keswick stops by the church.
words.example_sl: Avtobus za Keswick ustavi pri cerkvi.
words.example_it: L'autobus per Keswick si ferma vicino alla chiesa.
words.example_de: Der Bus nach Keswick hält bei der Kirche.

words.example_en: Poppy goes to school on foot.
words.example_it: Poppy va a scuola a piedi.
words.example_de: Poppy geht zu Fuß zur Schule.
words.note: One foot, two feet, but always on foot.
words.note_sl: One foot, two feet (stopalo, stopali), a vedno on foot.
words.note_it: One foot, two feet (piede, piedi), ma sempre on foot.
words.note_de: One foot, two feet (Fuß, Füße), aber immer on foot.

words.example_en: Excuse me, where is the post office?
words.example_it: Mi scusi, dov'è l'ufficio postale?
words.example_de: Entschuldigung, wo ist die Post?
words.note: For more than one: Where are the sheep?
words.note_sl: Za več stvari: Where are the sheep? (Kje so ovce?)
words.note_it: Per più cose: Where are the sheep? (Dove sono le pecore?)
words.note_de: Für mehrere: Where are the sheep? (Wo sind die Schafe?)

words.example_en: Turn right at the church.
words.example_it: Alla chiesa gira a destra.
words.example_de: An der Kirche biegst du rechts ab.
words.note: Right also means correct: That's right!
words.note_sl: Right pomeni tudi pravilno: That's right! (Tako je!)
words.note_it: Right vuol dire anche giusto: That's right! (Esatto!)
words.note_de: Right heißt auch richtig: That's right! (Genau!)

words.example_en: The shop is on the left.
words.example_it: Il negozio è a sinistra.
words.example_de: Der Laden ist links.

words.example_en: Go straight on to the bridge.
words.example_it: Vai sempre dritto fino al ponte.
words.example_de: Geh geradeaus bis zur Brücke.

words.example_en: The post office is near the church.
words.example_it: L'ufficio postale è vicino alla chiesa.
words.example_de: Die Post ist in der Nähe der Kirche.

words.example_en: Sooty the lamb is behind the hay barn!
words.example_it: L'agnellino Sooty è dietro il fienile!
words.example_de: Das Lamm Sooty ist hinter der Heuscheune!
words.note: The opposite: in front of. Sooty is behind the barn, Jack is in front of it.
words.note_sl: Nasprotje: in front of (pred). Sooty je za senikom, Jack pred njim.
words.note_it: Il contrario: in front of (davanti a). Sooty è dietro il fienile, Jack davanti.
words.note_de: Das Gegenteil: in front of (vor). Sooty ist hinter der Scheune, Jack davor.
